cohort: 635 children aged 6 to 12 years old from Isfahan elementary schools
finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with general childhood obesity, but not abdominal obesity, after controlling for potential confounders.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with general childhood obesity after controlling for potential confounders (OR: 2.46; 95% CI: 1.30-4.63, p = 0.005).
